---
title: "Test Clean Tables"
output: 
  bookdown::pdf_document2:
    extra_dependencies: ["amsmath", "graphicx", "booktabs", "float"]
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

format_table <- function(x, caption = NULL, font_size = 8.5, col_widths = NULL) {
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    k <- knitr::kable(x, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE)
    k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, font_size = font_size, latex_options = "HOLD_position")
    if (!is.null(col_widths)) {
      for (col_idx in names(col_widths)) {
        k <- kableExtra::column_spec(k, as.numeric(col_idx), width = col_widths[[col_idx]])
      }
    }
    return(k)
  } else {
    return(knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE))
  }
}
```

```{r table-7-test}
threshold_df <- data.frame(
  Decision_Context = c(
    "Head-to-Head Parity (Risk > 6%)",
    "Head-to-Head Parity (Risk > 4%)",
    "Head-to-Head Parity (Observed)",
    "Practice Transition (S-ICD > 6% vs. TV-ICD Obs)"
  ),
  Break_Even_25k = c("£12,761 (-26.8%)", "£12,753 (-26.8%)", "£12,620 (-27.6%)", "£22,230 (+27.5%)"),
  Break_Even_35k = c("£12,773 (-26.7%)", "£12,765 (-26.8%)", "£12,631 (-27.5%)", "£25,469 (+46.1%)"),
  Current_ICER = c("Dominated", "Dominated", "Dominated", "£10,198 / QALY"),
  Economic_Mechanism = c(
    "Must be discounted ~£2,550 below TV-ICD list price (£15,317) to offset 8-yr vs 10-yr battery replacement penalty.",
    "Must offset higher 30-year replacement frequency across 1,103 implanted patients.",
    "Must offset replacement burden under unguided historic selection.",
    "Risk > 6% clinical efficiency (avoiding low-risk implants) cross-subsidizes S-ICD premium."
  )
)
colnames(threshold_df) <- c("Decision Context", "Break-Even (£25k)", "Break-Even (£35k)", "Current ICER", "Economic Rationale")

format_table(
  threshold_df,
  caption = "Price threshold analysis for S-ICD hardware and replacement costs (Current S-ICD list price: £17,434).",
  font_size = 8.5,
  col_widths = list("5" = "6cm")
)
```
